# Search for all simulator devices and list them
simulator_path="/Users/radoniusz/Library/Developer/CoreSimulator/Devices"

# Find the device with UDID matching our target
target_device="05DAB996-91A2-4038-922B-4F090146B5E9"

# List all devices
ls -d "$simulator_path"/* 2>/dev/null | while read device_dir; do
    device_name=$(cat "$device_dir/device.plist" 2>/dev/null | grep -A1 "UDID" | tail -1 | sed 's/.*<string>//;s/<\/string>.*//')
    if [ "$device_name" = "$target_device" ]; then
        echo "Found device: $device_dir"
        echo "Looking for Bluesky app data..."
        
        # Search for Bluesky app data in this device
        find "$device_dir/data/Containers/Data/Application" -maxdepth 2 2>/dev/null | while read app_data; do
            if [ -d "$app_data" ]; then
                # Check if this looks like the Bluesky app
                metadata_file="$app_data/.com.apple.mobile_container_manager.metadata.plist"
                if [ -f "$metadata_file" ]; then
                    echo "Checking: $app_data"
                    # Show the metadata to identify the app
                    grep -o '<key>MCMMetadataIdentifier</key><string>[^<]*' "$metadata_file" 2>/dev/null || echo "No identifier found"
                fi
            fi
        done
        break
    fi
done
